_about: Why a function stays hand-written (build/overrides*.c); read by tools/overrides_report.py for docs/OVERRIDES.md. Twin test = build/mixdiff/twin.sh: the generated twin against the original machine code.
bmp_bitmap_Alloc: its second switch (0x004ce4a6) has no bounds check of its own: the decompiler cannot recover the jump table, and a jump-table override prints only the first case of each shared destination (formats 7..12 would fall out)
fob_flobdec_blocky16_config: walks its varargs through REGISTER0X(0x10) (ESP); twin test: 7,612 of 30,000 differ
fob_block_maketiles: twin test: writes a split-mask byte the original does not (14,863 of 30,000 differ)
Blocky16_DecodeBlocks: register convention: source and destination in ESI / EDI, both returned advanced; the twin calls the block decoder with unaff_EDI / unaff_ESI and crashes
Blocky16_DecodeBlock8: register convention of the block decoders (ESI / EDI in and out); only reachable through Blocky16_DecodeBlocks
block16_RenderBlock4: register convention of the block decoders (ESI / EDI in and out)
block16_RenderBlock2: register convention of the block decoders (ESI / EDI in and out)
InsaneTimer_StopThread: the twin compares unaff_ESI with STILL_ACTIVE where the original reads the exit code it just stored (its test passes only because the recorded calls do not depend on it)
LecShare_Subscribe: undecided: misc_test's group needs the overrides rebuilt with -Dmalloc=test_malloc, which twin.sh does not do
gz_open: undecided: misc_test's group needs the overrides rebuilt with -Dmalloc=test_malloc, which twin.sh does not do
gz_putLong: undecided: misc_test's group needs the overrides rebuilt with -Dmalloc=test_malloc, which twin.sh does not do
DSound_GetPlayBlock: GRIM_SIMTIME hook: the play cursor follows the simulated clock
Input_PollKeyboard: twin test: crashes (lost DirectInput call arguments)
stdDisplay_EnumDevicesCallback: twin test: crashes (DirectDrawEnumerate callback, unaff_ registers)
D3D_InitRenderState: twin test: crashes (the execute buffer descriptor comes from unaff_ registers)
msc_MemSet: the original returns the count, left in EAX by the callee's pushad / popad; twin test: 1,448 of 12,301 differ
MaterialInstanceSaveLoad: called with five arguments, Ghidra sees in_stack_ reads; twin test: crashes
_math: build/difftest/asm_p2/math_test.c: the twins differ in the x87 rounding
rdClip_FaceToPlane: x87-exact; twin test: 136,054 of 100,000 calls differ
Script_Update: calls Script_SetSequence with a hidden register argument (the dispatcher's ESI)
Costume_ApplyScale: deliberate fix: the same scale factor for all components, the reciprocal stored once per call
Cos_AllocCostumeSlot: deliberate fix: the original leaves records undefined after a failed allocation
Cos_AllocInstanceSlot: deliberate fix: the original leaves records undefined after a failed allocation
Collision_TestActorAgainstOthers: x87-exact: the twin differs in NaN compares
Input_CreateMouse: its SetCooperativeLevel call is pushed around a Win_GetMainHwnd() call and the DIPROPDWORD is a lost stack block
Input_CreateKeyboard: sets a cooperative level the original does not (deliberate)
std3D_DrawRenderList: the execute-buffer descriptor comes from EDI
Im_RunTriggerCommand: the twin calls the callback with the marker alone; the code pushes eleven words
luaO_equalObj: TEST AH,0x40 after FCOMPP: an unordered compare counts as equal, the twin's == does not
luaV_tostring: its twin converts the word as an integer and its sprintf lost the number
math_abs: its local is undefined4, compared as an integer
sputText_CreateActorText: the generated text passes unaff_EBX / unaff_EDI / unaff_EBP to its callees
sputLua_Startup: registers the build's mod API functions
Lua_Print_NoOp: the debug log of the scripted tests (GRIM_DEBUGLOG); the retail game registers an empty function
stdMemory_CheckMagic: the guard word is the original allocator's; the host heap has none (a no-op here)
stdFileOpen: host runtime: text-mode reads (CR LF to LF) emulated over binary files
stdFileRead: host runtime: text-mode reads (CR LF to LF)
stdFileGets: host runtime: text-mode reads (CR LF to LF)
Main_Service: the frame-time hook of the scripted tests (g_fixedFrameMs)
Math_Sqrt: x87: FLD x; FSQRT; RET, the result stays in ST0 unrounded
Math_Floor: x87: FRNDINT under the round-down control word, which the decompiler does not see
stdMath_NormalizeAngle: x87: stores the result in a float local and compares that with 360.0
rdVector_Normalize3: x87: leaves |v| unrounded in ST0 for its caller
Script_SetState: the twin passes unaff_EDI / unaff_ESI / the return address on to Script_Trans (register arguments of the dispatcher)
Script_Trans: its callers pass register arguments (the dispatcher ESI); the twin reads unaff_ registers
stdDisplay_VBufferNew: the DirectDraw palette loop reads the palette argument from a stack slot the decompiler lost (puStack_8, never set) and drops the 0x40 flags of entries 0 and 255; the two allocations have their file / line arguments now (call-site overrides)
Actor_UpdateWalker: hook: the build's walk-speed mod API (SetWalkSpeedScale, g_fWalkSpeedScale) scales the walk step; otherwise the original
Insane_BlitRows16: fast path: the per-pixel copy of a movie frame dominated the movie loop; the hand-written copy gives the same pixels
sputLua_GetVisibleThingsL: deliberate fix: when the argument is neither nil nor an actor the original reads an uninitialised stack slot as the viewer (the rebuild read a null pointer and crashed, grim_tools cleanroom args_GetVisibleThings_tab)
Collision_PointInBox: stack aliasing: the original copies the box out of its parameter slots (rep movsd into the outgoing arguments), then reuses those slots for the moved end point; the decompiler orders the stores before the copy, so the twin passes the moved point as the box
ImSoundCall: commands 0x11 and 0x14 read argument 15, four words beyond what any caller pushes (garbage in the original); the hand-written version takes a11, equal to every argument the two callers pass
Im_MixLoopC: the byte-swapped big-endian sample is sign-extended (MOVSX EAX,AX); the decompiler prints (int)CONCAT11(lo, hi), which C zero-extends: negative samples come out as 65536 - |x|
Im_MixLoopD: the byte-swapped big-endian sample is sign-extended (MOVSX EAX,AX); the decompiler prints (int)CONCAT11(lo, hi), which C zero-extends: negative samples come out as 65536 - |x|
